messages.subject: Project Forge — draft strategy & risk note for the board
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Draft of the jurisdiction & strategy note attached for your review before it goes to the Pennington board. Headlines: jurisdiction near-certain on the share-of-supply test; turnover test not met; realistic prospect of an SLC on the narrow municipal-water frame; recommend proactive engagement plus a UIL package (divest the Aqualis water line) held in reserve. Tom has cross-checked the share figures against the management accounts.

Grateful for comments.

James

messages.subject: RE: Project Forge — draft strategy & risk note for the board
messages.plaintextBody:
Good note. Two points: (1) be firmer that we are NOT contesting jurisdiction — I don't want the board thinking that's a live battle; (2) flag the IEO risk more prominently, the board needs to understand the hold-separate obligations are coming and that breaches carry 5% turnover penalties. Otherwise fine to send once Calderon have sanity-checked the share denominators.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP

T +44 (0)20 7946 0512
